name: ab-marketing
description: Marketing agent brigade: the standard brigade surface — mise (readiness gate), expo (the composing coordinator that decomposes a marketing request and fires the stations it needs, incl. compound asks like drafting a brief AND its measurement plan), service (the on/off switch) — over eval-proven marketing stations. Three live generative stations (the marketplace's first exemplar-graded generative skills, eval rubrics derived from real GAO campaign-evaluation and S-1 positioning gold): effectiveness-narrative-draft (+1.00), positioning-narrative-draft (+0.80/+1.00 across rounds), marketing-brief-draft (+0.80 both rounds). MENU.md carries honest held-for-refire status with real measured evidence for three structural FTC coverage-review stations (near-miss profiles documented). Structural stations report coverage, never legal advice. Only eval-passers ship; eval reports in evals/.
